commits.message:
c*(k) ≤ 4⌈√(2k−7)⌉ − 1 for every k ≥ 7, in Lean (filled L-shape with two top layers)

RyuEnds.lean: Ryu's Lemma 5.1 in general form (a lifted band plus any packings of its two end
regions packs the strip; separation by the rotated coordinate), the rotation by pi, a half-plane
separation lemma, and axis layers in an end region.

RyuLayers.lean: with b = ⌈√(2k−7)⌉ and L − 3 rows per band, the four band ends get ⌊(b−1)/2⌋,
⌊(b−1)/2⌋, ⌊b/2⌋ and ⌊b/2⌋+1 (+1 in a second layer) axis squares: 2b in all, so k² − 4b squares
pack in side < k (six more than RyuFill). This matches the best axis-fill count of the construction
over all b for 7 ≤ k ≤ 3·10⁵ (search/ryu/r1prime.py). Standard axioms only.

search/ryu/endcost.py: end cost of axis fills vs Ryu's staircase end (exploration).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ryu's c*(k) < 20.668 k^{2/5} + 0.623 in Lean, for every k ≥ 8·10⁶ (staircase band ends)

RyuStair.lean: the staircase end (Ryu §6, after Bui §3): tilted columns, axis layers and wedge rows
pack an end region when each fits and the pieces are separated pairwise by U = X cos α + Y sin α or by
height; finite unions of closed regions (PacksIn.biUnion).
RyuStairCount.lean: the parameters (m, I, J_i, J₁, layers to ⌊g(ξ_I − ḡ tan α)⌋, wedge rows), the
packing (EndP.packs) and the count N ≥ lb in closed form (EndP.count; floors lose ≤ 1 each).
RyuStairEnd.lean: with tan(α/2) = (√2 + 1/v)/v and a lift y ∈ [3v²/4, 3v²/4 + 2], the end cost
A₀(y) − N ≤ 4.33 v² + 11 v + 30 (end_bound), via an exact identity for area − lb and six term bounds.
RyuStairBound.lean: the L-shape with all four band ends staircased (packs_stair: k² − c pack for
c ≥ 4k/b + 4(4.33 v² + 11 v + 30)), then c*(k) < 18.9 k^{2/5} + 35.7 k^{1/5} + 122 for k ≥ 3·10⁵
(packs_stair_k25) and Ryu's Theorem 1.2 bound for k ≥ 8·10⁶ (Ryu: k ≥ 1.6·10⁷; packs_ryu_thm12).
Standard axioms only.

search/ryu/staircase.py: the same end construction in floats; exact-floor end cost vs lb vs Eub.
